name: Health and Wellness
use: Student health centre: Health & Wellness, Psychological and Counseling Services (PACS) and Student Accessibility Services (SAS)

facts.text: Campus health services were first in Hood House; the current Health Services Center was built in 1989 and its name made official on January 25, 1990.
Health & Wellness, PACS and Student Accessibility Services are now together in the Wellness Center building at 4 Pettee Brook Lane.

photos.caption: Brick gabled facade with tall narrow windows and a covered walkway sign

verdict: Modest 1989 gabled brick clinic now housing health, counselling and accessibility services together.
notes: Photo shows a two-storey red-brick building with steep gabled roofs, tall narrow windows and a small gabled entrance canopy, partly hidden by a large tree: competent and modest. Notunh name 'Health Services' is dated; UNH now calls it the Health & Wellness Center / Wellness Center. I found no date for when PACS and SAS moved in, no architect, no renovation history and no student reviews of the building.
judgeNotes: Photo shows a competent small brick building; little else documented.
